title: Decision
description: What an agent returns at one decision step: per-instrument orders, an optional free-text rationale, and an optional self-reported compute spend. This schema is authoritative for the SharpeBench agent wire contract and is closed: the Rust types carry #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)], so an unknown key is rejected at the transport boundary and scored as an agent protocol fault. Every decision must be a deterministic function of the observations of the same run up to and including the one being answered and of the agent's own earlier decisions in that run; wall-clock time, ambient randomness and state carried in from outside the run are not allowed. Re-execution verification re-drives the agent and refuses the first decision whose orders or cost differ from the recorded one (reasoning and rationale are not compared).

orders.description: Per-instrument instructions. May be empty (a hold). At most one order per symbol, and every symbol must appear in the observation being answered.

reasoning.description: Free-text rationale captured into the trajectory for auditability. Optional; defaults to empty.

cost.description: Self-reported compute spend for producing this decision. Optional; omitted entirely when not reported. The engine accumulates it into the run cost that drives the cost-normalized leaderboard columns.

DecisionCost.description: Self-reported spend for one decision. Every field defaults to zero, so a partial report still validates. cost_usd must be finite and nonnegative.

cost_usd.description: Dollar cost of the compute/tokens spent on this decision. The preferred unit for skill-per-dollar reporting.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning/thinking tokens, surfaced separately as a legibility breakdown. Providers typically already bill these inside tokens_out, so they are not re-added to the token total.

Order.description: One per-instrument instruction. Applying it moves the portfolio toward target_weight; the engine applies each accepted decision's orders exactly once per step and never retries them.

symbol.description: The instrument this order targets. Must be one of the symbols the observation offered.

action.description: Discrete action label (sizing is carried by target_weight). Deliberately not inferred from the target sign: it is an audit label, and the signed target remains authoritative.

target_weight.description: Target portfolio weight for this symbol in [-1, 1]; negative values are shorts.

confidence.description: Stated conviction in [0, 1]; scored for calibration. Optional; defaults to 0.5.

rationale.description: Optional one-line rationale for this order, captured into the run trace. Defaults to empty.
